te: Warsaw falls without resistance to a small force under the command of Charles X Gustav of Sweden during The Deluge, mak…
dz: 大洪水期间，瑞典查理十世·古斯塔夫指挥的一小支部队毫无抵抗地攻克了华沙，这也是该城市首次被外国军队占领。
de: Warsaw falls without resistance to a small force under the command of Charles X Gustav of Sweden during The Deluge, making it the first time the city is captured by a foreign army.
